parts.html: The K-45 kitchen model is a contemporary U-shaped design in a minimalist style, created for spacious kitchens, open-plan interiors, and kitchen-living spaces. The composition combines light beige fronts, tall wood-effect units in a light walnut tone, and a bold dark working zone with a stone countertop and matching backsplash. This makes the kitchen feel warm, refined, and visually premium.

The key design feature of K-45 is the contrast between the calm light cabinetry and the darker stone working surfaces. The upper and lower fronts are finished in a soft beige tone that forms a neutral interior base. On the left side, tall units in a wood-effect finish add depth and warmth to the composition. One of these units includes an open niche that lightens the vertical block visually and can be used for decoration or practical storage.

The working area is finished with a stone countertop and a matching dark backsplash with expressive light and warm veining. This creates a visually unified composition and reinforces the contemporary character of the model.
Layout and dimensions
K-45 has a U-shaped configuration, with cabinetry and working surfaces arranged along three sides.
The total linear length of the kitchen is 8 meters, and the standard dimensions are 8 × 2.3 × 0.9 m.

One section extends into a peninsula with a bar area, which can also be considered the island element of the model. In the interior visualization, this area includes seating for two, making it suitable for casual dining, communication, and everyday use.
Materials and cabinet construction
The upper and lower cabinet fronts are made of foil fronts.
The cabinet structure is made from 18 mm laminated chipboard.
Visually, the main fronts are finished in a light beige tone, while the tall side units use a warm wood-effect decor. This combination works well in minimalist and contemporary interiors.
Hardware and functionality
The standard K-45 specification includes the AVENTOS HF lift system for upper cabinets.
Hinged elements use Hettich soft-close hinges.
Pull-out elements use Atira Hettich drawer systems.
A cargo storage system is included as standard.
Handles are also included, while the visual concept features clean dark profile lines that support the minimalist look of the cabinetry.
Built-in appliances

K-45 is designed for built-in appliances. In the visualization, the appliances are integrated into the tall wood-effect cabinet block, helping preserve a clean furniture composition and comfortable ergonomics.
Island / peninsula and bar area

An important feature of the model is the island / peninsula element, which extends the working surface and forms a practical bar area. This makes the kitchen more versatile for everyday living and interaction.
The dark stone countertop continues across this element, visually connecting the entire kitchen into one composition.
Optional upgrades
Upon request, K-45 can be equipped with more functional furniture hardware, additional storage systems, and alternative opening mechanisms.
The kitchen can also be produced using alternative materials ranging from budget-friendly to premium options. These items are optional upgrades and are not part of the base standard configuration.

Custom K-45 kitchen in Bratislava and Vienna
DUMSKAYA DESIGN, based in Bratislava, Slovakia, provides custom kitchen design, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation in Bratislava and Vienna.
The K-45 model can be used as a serial base solution and then adapted to the specific room dimensions, appliance layout, peninsula configuration, internal storage, and material preferences.
